clues.text: When Moses asked him to let Israel go, he replied, "Who is the LORD that I should obey His voice?"
He dreamed by the Nile that seven thin cows ate seven fat ones, and no magician could explain it.
He took the signet ring from his own finger and put it on Joseph's hand.
He ordered that every Hebrew baby boy be thrown into the Nile, but the girls could live.
His daughter went down to bathe in the Nile and found baby Moses in a basket among the reeds.
He got his chariot ready and chased the Israelites, but his whole army drowned in the sea.
At his birthday feast in Joseph's day, he gave the cupbearer his job back but hanged the chief baker.
